SELECT
    *
FROM
    object
INNER JOIN
    probability
ON
    object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE
    object.firstMJD > 60173.0
    and object.firstMJD < 60177.0
    AND probability.class_name='SN'
    AND probability.classifier_name='stamp_classifier'
    AND probability.ranking=1
    AND (probability.probability>0.5
    OR object.ndet>1)

sql_query:
-- Query to retrieve objects first classified as SN by the stamp classifier between August 17 and August 21,
-- with a probability greater than 0.5 or at least having two detections.

SELECT *
FROM object
WHERE oid IN (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND class_name = 'SN'
      AND probability > 0.5
      AND oid IN (
          SELECT oid
          FROM object
          WHERE firstmjd BETWEEN 60173.0 AND 60177.0
      )
)
OR ndet >= 2

-- Query to retrieve all objects first classified as SN by the stamp classifier between August 17 and August 21,
-- with a probability greater than 0.5 or at least having two detections.

FROM object
WHERE oid IN (
    -- Subquery to filter objects based on classification and probability
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' -- Filter for the stamp classifier
      AND class_name = 'SN' -- Filter for the SN class
      AND ranking = 1 -- Ensure it's the first classification
      AND probability > 0.5 -- Probability greater than 0.5
)
AND firstmjd BETWEEN 60173.0 AND 60177.0 -- Filter for objects first detected between August 17 and August 21
AND (ndet >= 2 OR oid IN (
    -- Subquery to include objects with at least two detections
    SELECT oid
    FROM object
    WHERE ndet >= 2
))

-- Query to retrieve objects classified as AGN with specific conditions
SELECT 
    o.oid, -- Object identifier
    f.value, -- Feature value
    f.name, -- Feature name
    f.version, -- Feature version
    f.fid AS feature_fid, -- Filter ID from the feature table
    o.meanra, -- Mean right ascension
    o.meandec, -- Mean declination
    o.ndet, -- Total number of detections for the object
    MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_g, -- Minimum magnitude in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_g, -- Maximum magnitude in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS delta_mag_g, -- Magnitude variation in g band
    MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_r, -- Minimum magnitude in r band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_r, -- Maximum magnitude in r band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS delta_mag_r -- Magnitude variation in r band
FROM 
    object o
WHERE 
    o.oid IN (
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE p.class_name = 'AGN' -- Classified as AGN
          AND p.probability > 0.6 -- Probability larger than 0.6
          AND p.ranking = 1 -- Most probable class
    )
    AND o.deltajd >= 365 -- Light curve covering at least one year
    AND o.ndet >= 20 -- At least 20 detections
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM feature f
        WHERE f.oid = o.oid
          AND f.fid = 1 -- g band
          AND MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) > 1 -- Variation > 1 magnitude in g band
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM feature f
        WHERE f.oid = o.oid
          AND f.fid = 2 -- r band
          AND MAX(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) > 0.5 -- Variation > 0.5 magnitude in r band
    )
GROUP BY 
    o.oid, f.value, f.name, f.version, f.fid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet

-- Query to retrieve objects classified as AGN with specific conditions
SELECT 
    o.oid, -- Object identifier
    f.value, -- Feature value
    f.name, -- Feature name
    f.version, -- Feature version
    f.fid AS feature_fid, -- Filter ID from the feature table
    o.meanra, -- Mean right ascension
    o.meandec, -- Mean declination
    o.ndet, -- Total number of detections for the object
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_g, -- Minimum magnitude in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_g, -- Maximum magnitude in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_r, -- Minimum magnitude in r band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_r, -- Maximum magnitude in r band
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_g, -- Variation in g band
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_r -- Variation in r band
FROM 
    object o
WHERE 
    o.oid IN (
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE p.class_name = 'AGN' -- Classified as AGN
          AND p.probability > 0.6 -- Probability larger than 0.6
          AND p.ranking = 1 -- Most probable class
    )
    AND (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365 -- Light curve covering at least one year
    AND o.ndet >= 20 -- At least 20 detections
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM feature f
        WHERE f.oid = o.oid
          AND f.name IN ('min_mag', 'max_mag') -- Features for magnitude
          AND f.fid IN (1, 2) -- g and r bands
          AND (
              (f.fid = 1 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' THEN f.value END) - 
                              MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' THEN f.value END)) > 1) -- Variation > 1 in g band
              OR
              (f.fid = 2 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' THEN f.value END) - 
                              MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' THEN f.value END)) > 0.5) -- Variation > 0.5 in r band
          )
    )
GROUP BY 
    o.oid, f.value, f.name, f.version, f.fid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet

    o.oid, -- Object identifier
    f.value, -- Feature value
    f.name, -- Feature name
    f.version, -- Feature version

    o.meanra, -- Mean right ascension

    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_g, -- Maximum magnitude in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS delta_mag_g, -- Variation in g band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_r, -- Minimum magnitude in r band
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_r, -- Maximum magnitude in r band

    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS delta_mag_r -- Variation in r band
FROM 
    object o
WHERE 
    o.oid IN (
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE p.class_name = 'AGN' 
          AND p.probability > 0.6 
          AND p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
          AND p.ranking = 1
    )
    AND o.deltajd >= 365 -- Light curve covering at least one year

-- Using a WITH clause to optimize the query and define intermediate results
WITH 
-- Subquery to get the first detection and last non-detection for each object in the same filter
first_last_detections AS (
    SELECT 
        d.oid,
        d.fid AS detection_fid,
        d.mjd AS first_detection_mjd,
        nd.mjd AS last_non_detection_mjd,
        (d.magpsf - nd.diffmaglim) / (d.mjd - nd.mjd) AS initial_rise_rate
    FROM 
        detection d
    JOIN 
        non_detection nd
    ON 
        d.oid = nd.oid AND d.fid = nd.fid
    WHERE 
        d.mjd > nd.mjd -- Ensure the non-detection is before the detection
),
-- Subquery to filter objects that qualify as fast risers
fast_risers AS (
    SELECT 
        f.oid,
        f.detection_fid,
        f.first_detection_mjd,
        f.last_non_detection_mjd,
        f.initial_rise_rate
    FROM 
        first_last_detections f
    WHERE 
        f.initial_rise_rate >= 0.25 -- Fast riser condition
),
-- Subquery to get the highest probability in the stamp classifier for class SN
highest_stamp_prob AS (
    SELECT 
        p.oid,
        p.probability
    FROM 
        probability p
    WHERE 
        p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' 
        AND p.class_name = 'SN'
        AND p.ranking = 1 -- Highest probability
),
-- Subquery to filter objects with first detection in the first 2 days of September
september_detections AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.oid,
        fr.detection_fid,
        fr.first_detection_mjd,
        fr.last_non_detection_mjd,
        fr.initial_rise_rate
    FROM 
        fast_risers fr
    WHERE 
        fr.first_detection_mjd BETWEEN 60188.0 AND 60189.0 -- First 2 days of September
)
-- Main query to combine all the results and include non-detections and magstat information
SELECT 
    sd.oid,
    hsp.probability,
    nd.fid AS non_detection_fid,
    nd.diffmaglim,
    ms.fid AS magstat_fid,
    sd.initial_rise_rate
FROM 
    september_detections sd
JOIN 
    highest_stamp_prob hsp
ON 
    sd.oid = hsp.oid
LEFT JOIN 
    non_detection nd
ON 
    sd.oid = nd.oid
LEFT JOIN 
    magstat ms
ON 
    sd.oid = ms.oid
ORDER BY 
    sd.oid
LIMIT 100

SELECT o.oid, o.meanra, o.meandec

FROM (
SELECT
    object.oid, object.meanra, object.meandec
FROM
    object INNER JOIN
    probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE
    probability.classifier_name='lc_classifier'
    AND probability.class_name IN ('SNIa', 'SNIbc', 'SNII', 'SLSN')
    AND probability.ranking = 1
    AND object.firstmjd > 59988.0
    AND object.firstmjd < 60197.0
) as o
WHERE
    q3c_poly_query(o.meanra, o.meandec, '((-20, -20), (-2, -20), (20, 1), (10, 10))'::polygon);

-- Query to retrieve all SuperNovae (SNe) that first occurred between February 13 and September 10
-- and are within the specified polygon. The query returns the oids, mean right ascension (meanra), and mean declination (meandec).

WITH sne_objects AS (
    -- Subquery to filter objects classified as SuperNovae (SNe) based on the probability table
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_transient'
      AND class IN ('SNIa', 'SNIbc', 'SNII', 'SLSN') -- All types of SuperNovae
      AND ranking = 1 -- Most probable class
)
SELECT o.oid, o.meanra, o.meandec
FROM object o
WHERE o.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM sne_objects) -- Filter for SNe objects
  AND o.firstmjd BETWEEN 59988.0 AND 60197.0 -- First occurrence between February 13 and September 10
  AND q3c_poly_query(o.meanra, o.meandec, '((-20, -20), (-2, -20), (20, 1), (10, 10))'::polygon) -- Within the specified polygon

-- Query to retrieve ALLWISE objects within a 1 arcsec radius from the specified coordinates
WITH catalog (source_id, ra, dec) AS (
    VALUES ('search_center', 23.6488, 30.7314) -- Define the search center coordinates
)
SELECT 
    a.oid_catalog, -- Identifier in the ALLWISE catalog
    a.ra,          -- Right Ascension
    a.dec,         -- Declination
    a.w1mpro,      -- WISE W1 magnitude
    a.w1sigmpro,   -- WISE W1 magnitude uncertainty
    a.w2mpro,      -- WISE W2 magnitude
    a.w2sigmpro,   -- WISE W2 magnitude uncertainty
    a.j_m_2mass,   -- 2MASS J magnitude
    a.j_msig_2mass -- 2MASS J magnitude uncertainty
FROM 
    allwise a
JOIN 
    catalog c
ON 
    q3c_radial_query(a.ra, a.dec, c.ra, c.dec, 1.0 / 3600.0) -- 1 arcsec radius converted to degrees

CREATE TABLE allwise (
    oid_catalog VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, /* object Id inside catalog, correspond to column: designation  in ALLWISE : Sexagesimal, equatorial position-based source name in the form: hhmmss.ss+ddmmss.s. The full naming convention for AllWISE Source Catalog sources has the form "WISEA  Jhhmmss.ss+ddmmss.s," where "WISEA" indicates the source is from the AllWISE Source Catalog, and "J" indicates the position is J2000. The "WISEA" acronym is not listed explicitly in the designation column. */
    ra DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* J2000 right ascension with respect to the 2MASS PSC reference frame from the non-moving source extraction. */
    dec DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* J2000 declination with respect to the 2MASS PSC reference frame from the non-moving source extraction. */
    w1mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* W1 magnitude measured with profile-fitting photometry, or the magnitude of the 95% confidence brightness upper limit if the W1 flux measurement has SNR<2. This column is null if the source is nominally detected in W1, but no useful brightness estimate could be made. */
    w2mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w3mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w4mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w1sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* W1 profile-fit photometric measurement uncertainty in mag units. This column is null if the W1 profile-fit magnitude is a 95% confidence upper limit or if the source is not measurable. */
    w2sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    w3sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    w4sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    j_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* 2MASS J-band magnitude or magnitude upper limit of the associated 2MASS PSC source. This column is "null" if there is no associated 2MASS PSC source or if the 2MASS PSC J-band magnitude entry is "null". */
    h_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to j_m_2mass */
    k_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to j_m_2mass */
    j_msig_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* 2MASS J-band corrected photometric uncertainty of the associated 2MASS PSC source. This column is "null" if there is no associated 2MASS PSC source or if the 2MASS PSC J-band uncertainty entry is "null". */
    h_msig_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to j_msig_2mass */
    k_msig_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION /* analogous to j_msig_2mass */
);

CREATE INDEX ix_allwise_dec ON allwise USING btree (dec);

-- Query to find at most 500 ZTF objects with the specified conditions
SELECT 
    o.oid AS "ZTF identifier", 
    p.classifier_version, 
    p.class_name, 
    p.probability
FROM 
    object o
WHERE 
    o.oid IN (
        SELECT d.oid
        FROM detection d
        WHERE d.fid = 1 -- g band filter
          AND d.corrected = TRUE -- no dubious corrections
          AND d.dubious = FALSE
        GROUP BY d.oid
        HAVING COUNT(d.oid) >= 10 -- minimum 10 detections in g band
    )

    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier' -- light curve classifier
      AND p.ranking = 1 -- only probabilities with ranking 1
)
ORDER BY o.oid
LIMIT 500

      AND probability > 0.6

SELECT *
FROM magstat
WHERE ndet >= 10 -- Minimum number of detections is 10
  AND magmedian > 19 -- Median difference magnitude fainter than 19
  AND maglast < 17 -- Last difference magnitude brighter than 17
ORDER BY oid -- Order the results by the object identifier
LIMIT 30 -- Limit the results to at most 30 rows

SELECT
    sq1.oid,
    ss_ztf.candid, ss_ztf.ssdistnr, ss_ztf.ssmagnr,
    ss_ztf.ssnamenr, dataquality.fid,
    dataquality.fwhm, dataquality.nmatches,
    dataquality.exptime
FROM
(
SELECT
    *
FROM
    probability
WHERE
    classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND class_name = 'asteroid'
    AND probability > 0.9
    AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
LIMIT 30
) as sq1
INNER JOIN
ss_ztf
ON sq1.oid = ss_ztf.oid
INNER JOIN
dataquality
ON ss_ztf.oid = dataquality.oid
AND ss_ztf.candid = dataquality.candid

-- Query to find at most 30 ZTF objects with a probability > 0.9 of being an asteroid in the stamp classifier version 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
-- The query retrieves the required columns from the relevant tables.

SELECT 
    p.oid AS ztf_object_id, -- Identifier of the ZTF object
    d.candid AS candidate_id, -- Candidate identifier
    s.ssdistnr AS distance_to_nearest_ss_object, -- Distance to the nearest Solar System object
    s.ssmagnr AS mpc_archive_magnitude, -- MPC archive magnitude
    s.ssnamenr AS ss_object_name, -- Name of the nearest Solar System object
    d.fid AS filter_id, -- Filter identifier
    NULL AS fwhm_sextractor, -- FWHM from SExtractor (not available in the schema)
    NULL AS num_ps1_calibrators, -- Number of PS1 calibrators used (not available in the schema)
    NULL AS exposure_time -- Exposure time (not available in the schema)
FROM 
    probability p
JOIN 
    detection d ON p.oid = d.oid
LEFT JOIN 
    ss_ztf s ON p.oid = s.oid
WHERE 
    p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' -- Stamp classifier
    AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4' -- Specific version of the classifier
    AND p.class_name = 'asteroid' -- Class name is asteroid
    AND p.probability > 0.9 -- Probability greater than 0.9
LIMIT 30 -- Limit the result to at most 30 rows

SELECT
    object.oid, ndet, firstmjd, lastmjd,
    probability, ss_ztf.candid, ssdistnr,
    ssnamenr, mjd, fid
FROM
    object INNER JOIN
    probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
    INNER JOIN
    ss_ztf
    ON object.oid = ss_ztf.oid
    INNER JOIN
    detection
    ON ss_ztf.oid = detection.oid
    AND ss_ztf.candid = detection.candid
WHERE
    ndet > 500
    AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND class_name = 'asteroid'
    AND probability > 0.5
    AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
    AND ssdistnr < 2
ORDER BY firstmjd
LIMIT 10

-- in the 'lc_classifier_1.2.1-P' feature version. Return all columns from

-- light curve classifier, with rankings either 1 or 2.

    LIMIT 100
)

SELECT
    sq1.oid, sq1.ndet, sq1.firstmjd,
    sq1.probability as prob_stamp_bogus,
    sq2.probability as prob_lc_transient
FROM
(
SELECT
    object.oid, object.ndet, object.firstmjd,
    probability.class_name,
    probability.probability
FROM
    object INNER JOIN
    probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE
    ndet > 10
    AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND class_name = 'bogus'
    AND probability > 0.7
    AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
) AS sq1
INNER JOIN
(
SELECT
    *
FROM
    probability
WHERE
    classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_top'
    AND class_name = 'Transient'
    AND probability > 0.9
) AS sq2
ON sq1.oid = sq2.oid
ORDER BY sq1.oid
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
    o.oid AS ztf_identifier, -- ZTF identifier
    o.ndet AS number_of_detections, -- Number of detections
    o.firstmjd AS first_detection_date, -- First detection date
    (SELECT p1.probability

       AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' 
       AND p1.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4') AS prob_stamp_bogus, -- Probability in the stamp classifier
    (SELECT p2.probability 
     FROM probability p2 
     WHERE p2.oid = o.oid 
       AND p2.class_name = 'transient'

SELECT
  sq.oid, sq.meanra, sq.meandec,
  detection.candid, detection.fid as f_id,detection.magpsf, detection.sigmapsf_corr, detection.sigmapsf_corr_ext
FROM
  (
SELECT
    object.oid, object.meanra, object.meandec, object.ndet
FROM
    object INNER JOIN
    probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE
    probability.classifier_name='lc_classifier_stochastic'
    AND probability.class_name='CV/Nova'
    AND probability.ranking = 1
) AS sq
  INNER JOIN detection
  ON sq.oid = detection.oid
WHERE
  sq.ndet < 50
  AND detection.fid = 2
ORDER BY oid
LIMIT 1000

-- Query to retrieve the required information based on the user's request
WITH highest_prob_cv_nova AS (
    -- Subquery to filter objects with the highest probability class as CV/Nova by the stochastic light curve classifier
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.class_name = 'CV/Nova'
      AND p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_stochastic'
      AND p.ranking = 1
),
filtered_objects AS (
    -- Subquery to filter objects with at most 50 detections
    SELECT o.oid
    FROM object o
    WHERE o.ndet <= 50
      AND o.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM highest_prob_cv_nova)
),
r_band_detections AS (
    -- Subquery to filter detections in the r-band filter (fid = 2) for the filtered objects
    SELECT d.oid, d.candid, d.fid, d.ra, d.dec, d.magpsf_corr, d.sigmapsf_corr
    FROM detection d
    WHERE d.fid = 2
      AND d.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
),
magnitude_analysis AS (
    -- Subquery to calculate the maximum rise from minimum in corrected PSF magnitude for each object
    SELECT 
        r.oid,
        r.candid,
        r.fid,
        r.ra,
        r.dec,
        r.magpsf_corr,
        r.sigmapsf_corr,
        MAX(r.magpsf_corr) - MIN(r.magpsf_corr) AS max_rise_from_min
    FROM r_band_detections r
    GROUP BY r.oid, r.candid, r.fid, r.ra, r.dec, r.magpsf_corr, r.sigmapsf_corr
)
-- Final query to retrieve the first 1000 rows, ordered by object identifier
SELECT 
    m.oid AS object_identifier,
    m.candid AS candidate_identifier,
    m.fid AS f_id,
    m.ra AS right_ascension,
    m.dec AS declination,
    m.magpsf_corr AS corrected_psf_magnitude,
    m.sigmapsf_corr AS magnitude_error,
    m.max_rise_from_min AS max_rise_from_minimum
FROM magnitude_analysis m
ORDER BY m.oid
LIMIT 1000
